primary_rule: B only; inside original Polyp Mask, exact native identity and certain mapping; distance<=2 native pixels -> V2 suppress; >2 retain

mask_coordinate_definition.native_to_archive: exact inherited K_archive @ inv(K_native), with half-pixel pixel centers
mask_coordinate_definition.distance: Euclidean distance from continuous mapped candidate center to nearest NON-Polyp original MASK PIXEL CENTER; not to cell edge; no extra0.5 subtraction
mask_coordinate_definition.metric_native_units: original y coordinates times352/360; original x times640/640
mask_coordinate_definition.implementation: original-mask exact scipy EDT for integer centers; equivalent KDTree for continuous mapped query
mask_coordinate_definition.membership: floor(archive_uv+0.5); native legacy label must agree; mismatch is exception, retained

V1: A2 exact baseline copies, including historical46 and A2red223
V3: mask all identity/membership/mapping-qualified orange; exceptions protected under explicit no-auto-delete rule; if any, report V3_ALL_B_INCOMPLETE, never silently drop them
safety: all non-B, redA prior exclusions, purpleC, greenD unchanged; outside/identity/mapping failures retained in V2/V3 and listed
crop: exact inherited make_crop with originalMask; A/K/c2w all unchanged, same nearest IDs

diagnostics.component: 8-connectivity for native/crop valid masks; holes=fill_holes(valid)-valid; no repair
diagnostics.body: distance>2 native px under primary ORIGINAL-mask metric; V1-fixed denominator
diagnostics.head: original nativePolyp connected component with maximum overlap of camera rays through inner Ring at RingZ=0
diagnostics.side: other original Polyp components; anatomical proxy, not certified tissue label
diagnostics.possible_thin: existing native medial-ridge width<=6 proxy diagnostic only; if none NOT_EVALUABLE, no new hard gate
diagnostics.fixed_cases: reuse A2 ref03/r04/r00 fixed original/selectedIDs; distinguish suppressed observation from corrected error
diagnostics.fixed_jump_denominator: V1 legal4-neighbour pairs; unavailable pairs reported separately
diagnostics.historical_3px_gate: REVOKED_BY_USER_FOR_A3_ONLY; historical GateA/A2 FAIL kept unchanged

acceptance: engineering integrity PASS required; scientific improvement assessed separately; no3px blocker; no GT certification of real surface loss; recommend at most controlled V1/V2 future ablation, not automatic GateB
